evidence: The present work demonstrates benefits gained by the combined use of TOF-ERDA and NRB techniques in the analysis of polycrystalline AIN thin films deposited by atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) [ 19-21 ]. These films have been grown from two different aluminium sources, AICI3 and AI(CH3) 3, and ammonia under such conditions where some contamination has arisen from the precursors.
